# ACE: the African Context Engine

> ACE gives checked, local, citable knowledge for Africa on any phone (USSD, SMS/RCS, voice, WhatsApp and MCP). USSD, SMS and voice are the default, so every phone is reached; WhatsApp and RCS show the sources under every answer for people with a smartphone and data, and RCS adds suggested replies and falls back to SMS. RCS is on the main branch and ships in the next release. It covers 34 countries in eight languages: English, Swahili, French, Portuguese, Arabic, Amharic, Afaan Oromo and Somali. Six decision services built on dated public data (rain this week, official warnings, nearest health facility, market prices, a pregnancy companion and a crop problem check) cover every country wherever open data exists and name the gap where it does not. Release 2.2 preview (2.2.0b2, 25 November 2026) added speech and translation: a language check on real speech text from Google's open WAXAL corpus, a voice line that speaks only languages with a known voice (Amharic and Somali through Gemini TTS), and optional Google Cloud speech and translation providers. Release 2.1 (24 November 2026) added 21 countries and five languages, with replies budgeted for the GSM-7 or UCS-2 alphabet each language needs. The caller's dialling code picks the country, a safety rail answers emergencies with that country's verified numbers before anything else runs, and every answer cites its published source. It runs without an AI model. Code is Apache 2.0; open context packs are CC BY 4.0. Created by Tom Bruno.

## Start here

- [Project page](https://tbrunoh.github.io/ace/): the problems ACE solves, how it works, coverage, V2 and answers to common questions
- Essays by the creator: [AI for Africa has to work on the phone people already own](https://tbrunoh.github.io/writing/ai-for-africa-basic-phones/) and [Africa's farm data is open. The last mile to farmers is the work left to do](https://tbrunoh.github.io/writing/africa-farm-data-last-mile/)
- [README](https://github.com/tbrunoh/african-context-engine/blob/main/README.md): what ACE does, coverage for all 34 countries and a quickstart
- [Architecture](https://github.com/tbrunoh/african-context-engine/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): the request flow, modules, retrieval, channel budgets, language models and the MCP server
- [Channels](https://github.com/tbrunoh/african-context-engine/blob/main/docs/channels.md): setup for USSD, SMS, RCS with SMS fallback, voice and WhatsApp
- [Context packs](https://github.com/tbrunoh/african-context-engine/blob/main/docs/context-packs.md): how sourced facts are written, reviewed and validated
- [Safety and privacy](https://github.com/tbrunoh/african-context-engine/blob/main/docs/safety-and-privacy.md): what the code guarantees, what every deployment must do and how to report a safety problem

## V2: design published and preview released, 24 and 25 November 2026

- [Speech and translation](https://github.com/tbrunoh/african-context-engine/blob/main/docs/speech.md): what exists to hear, speak and translate each of the eight languages, how ACE uses WAXAL, the WAXAL language results, the voice line rule, who pays for Google Cloud use and how to cap it, and the gaps
- [Release 2.1 design](https://github.com/tbrunoh/african-context-engine/blob/main/docs/v2/release-2.1.md): the 21 new countries, the five new languages, the alphabet each reply travels in, the five data problems ACE designs around, decisions and gaps
- [Languages](https://github.com/tbrunoh/african-context-engine/blob/main/docs/languages.md): the eight languages, how a person picks one, and how to add a ninth in one file
- [Back translation reports](https://github.com/tbrunoh/african-context-engine/blob/main/docs/reviews/README.md): machine back translations of every string in Portuguese, Arabic, Amharic, Afaan Oromo and Somali, with the rows fluent reviewers should check first
- [Services guide](https://github.com/tbrunoh/african-context-engine/blob/main/docs/services.md): the six services, their decision rules, coverage and gaps in all 34 countries, and how to call them over the API and MCP
- [Connectors](https://github.com/tbrunoh/african-context-engine/blob/main/docs/connectors/README.md): the public data sources, licences and refresh schedule behind the services
- [V2 overview](https://github.com/tbrunoh/african-context-engine/blob/main/docs/v2/README.md): twelve decision services built on public data, a voice line in African languages, signed knowledge and a shared grounding layer
- [Product spec](https://github.com/tbrunoh/african-context-engine/blob/main/docs/v2/product-spec.md): who V2 serves, the services, journeys, architecture, roadmap, measures and risks
- [Data and model catalog](https://github.com/tbrunoh/african-context-engine/blob/main/docs/v2/data-catalog.md): every public dataset and model V2 builds on, with access and licence
- [Build plan](https://github.com/tbrunoh/african-context-engine/blob/main/docs/v2/build-plan.md): epics, contracts and evaluation for building V2 with Google Antigravity
